about.description: DelRom is a thoughtfully designed hospitality space created to offer comfort, style, and a welcoming experience in every stay. It is meant to feel like a home away from home, blending functionality with carefully curated details that enhance each guest's experience. Its strategic location provides easy access to shopping areas, beaches, and key points of interest, making it an ideal choice for both leisure and business travelers. At DelRom, every stay is defined by ease, convenience, and an atmosphere that invites you to return.

testimonials.label: 04 — Guest Testimonials
testimonials.headline: Loved
testimonials.review1: Booked this place last minute (same day) and I have to say, this was the absolute best place we stayed at (out of 6 places during our 11 day stay in PR). Parking was extremely convenient, steps away (as described). Location was definitely the quietest too! Mattresses were extremely comfortable, linenes and towels were pristine. The little details and care is noticable from the snacks, cold water in the fridge, feminine products, coffee, tea, laundry detergent & softener was a huge +... We wished and asked if we could extend our stay, but it was booked already. Excellent host - HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
testimonials.review2: Clean, convenient, lots of room, 4 TVs, AC... perfect for last day in Puerto Rico... 10 min. from airport!
testimonials.review3: Everything was perfect. An impeccable, cozy space in a quiet setting. Highly recommended for a comfortable and pleasant stay.
